articles.summary: Vistance Networks NASDAQ VISN Vistance or the Company a global provider of intelligent network solutions today announced its Board of Directors the Board approved a special cash distribution of 1.50 per share payable on November 6 2026 to holders of record of its common stock as of the close of business on October 26 2026.
articles.title: Vistance Networks Board Approves Special Distribution

articles.summary: Vistance Networks NASDAQ VISN a global provider of intelligent network solutions plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday November 5 before the market opens.
articles.title: Vistance Networks to Release Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 5
